title: alchemilla vulgaris subvar. semisecta
intro: Alchemilla vulgaris subvar. semisecta, commonly known as Lady's Mantle, is a perennial herbaceous plant of the rosaceae family. It is prized for its emollient and protective properties, which make it a valuable remedy in traditional medicine. The health benefits of Lady's Mantle include its ability to soothe and calm irritated skin, reduce inflammation, and support menstrual health. The bioactive constituents of the plant include flavonoids, triterpenoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its therapeutic actions, including anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and anti-hemorrhagic effects.
